facts.fact: 锦玲（Kiamling）从"春芽阁"（Pavilion of Spring Buds）一路恍惚走回家；屋里静得反常、黑得反常，她脚趾撞到桌子，摔碎一只碗，划了四根火柴才点着灯。
facts.anchor: Kiamling walked home in a daze, reeling from everything she had seen and heard at the Pavilion of Spring Buds. The house was too quiet. Too dark.

facts.fact: 往常静玲（Jingling）会把晚饭剩菜留在炉火余烬边温着，婆婆（Por Por）会在她撞到要紧东西之前用拐杖戳她的脚、摇头表示不满——如今这些"往常"都不在了。
facts.anchor: Usually Jingling would have leftovers from dinner warming by the embers of the fire. Usually Por Por would jab at her feet with a walking stick before Kiamling knocked into anything of note, shaking her head with dissatisfaction.

facts.fact: 她随即想起婆婆是被一道裂隙（rift）拽走的，如今困在里面、甚至可能已经死了；自己那些怨气相比之下都显得渺小、小气。
facts.anchor: But then she remembered that Por Por had been pulled through a rift – trapped, if not… dead. All Kiamling’s grievances felt so small in comparison.

facts.fact: 婆婆一直供养着"lui gwei"（鬼魂），既不张扬也不求人道谢——这与"yiugwai"猎鬼人的正统教条相违背。
facts.anchor: Por Por had provided for the lui gwei. Without any fanfare or need for thanks. Something that went against the official teachings of yiugwai hunters.

facts.fact: 当年全家匆忙离开广州、她父母新丧还穿着孝服时，她自以为勤快，替婆婆收拾东西装箱，手腕被竹杖抽了一下；比疼更刺人的是"婆婆竟打了她"这件事本身，婆婆喝道："永远别碰那个。"
facts.anchor: the flick of the bamboo cane snapped on her wrist. The shock that her Por Por had struck her was what had stung more than anything. “Never touch that.”

facts.fact: 箱锁是四个可旋转的字筒，筒上刻着八个字：剑、灵、鬼、安抚、毁、家、黑、白（sword, spirit, ghost, appease, destroy, family, black, white）；每个筒刻的都是同样这八个字，须排出四个正确的字方能开锁。
facts.anchor: The barrel of the lock had four spinning cylinders with characters etched upon them. She spun one of them, reading the characters upon it: sword, spirit, ghost, appease, destroy, family, black, white.

facts.fact: 她自以为答案显而易见，得意地排出"剑·家·毁·鬼"四个字——锁却纹丝不动。
facts.anchor: Well, the answer was obvious. Kiamling was pleased with herself, lining up the characters: sword family destroy ghost.

facts.fact: 她先前当作"手艺粗糙"的地方其实是刻意留白——四字密码里的负空间："鬼〔无〕黑白"，锁咔嗒一声开了。
facts.anchor: What she had presumed at first was poor handiwork was in fact a deliberate blank. A negative space in the four character code: ghost [not] black white. The lock opened with a satisfying click.

facts.fact: 箱里是婆婆的账簿；她发现一个与所收费用对不上的数目，每月月末都出现，且逐月递减，连最近一本里仍剩不小一笔。
facts.anchor: A number that did not correspond to the charge made. There it was again, on another day. She opened books from different years. The number appeared at the end of each month, going down over time.

facts.fact: 那笔债自一家人离开广州起就由婆婆一点点偿还，还要再还好几年才清；她不明白婆婆究竟做了什么才欠下这样一笔钱。
facts.anchor: Por Por had been paying it off since they had left Canton. It would take another few years still to settle. What had she done to accumulate such a sum?

facts.fact: 最旧那本账簿底下掉出一张纸，锦玲打开：最初借款数额用粗体字写着，是一笔巨款。
facts.anchor: A slip of paper fell out of the oldest of the books, at the bottom of the chest. Kiamling opened it. The original loan amount was written in bold characters. A princely sum.

facts.fact: 债主既不是烟馆也不是麻将馆，而是广东省最大的有组织犯罪帮会；债款按月分期支付，用来安置、供养南京城周边流离失所的人。
facts.anchor: It was neither an opium den nor a mahjong house. It was the biggest organised criminal gang in Canton province.

facts.fact: 南京城被太平天国大军围困并攻陷，时在欧家（Au family）迁往香港前后。
facts.anchor: The imperial city of Nanjing had been besieged and had fallen to the overwhelming numbers of the Taiping Rebellion forces around the time the Au family had moved to Hong Kong.

facts.fact: 不论缘由，下一期还款一周内就到期；上个月她们在广州求助时，想必已经漏缴了一期。
facts.anchor: Whatever the reason, the next payment was nearly due. In a week’s time. She must have missed last month’s when they were in Canton seeking help.

facts.fact: 债并不在她名下，本可以不管；她听说讨债人会砍手示警，自己倒想看他们试试——可万一他们找上静玲呢？
facts.anchor: the debt was not in her name. What could they do? She had heard of debt collectors cutting off a hand in warning. She would like to see them try… but what if they came for Jingling?

facts.fact: 她急需一笔钱，想过向茶楼的老板（louban）开口，但他会追问不休，整个华人社群都会议论她为何向雇主借钱。
facts.anchor: Kiamling needed money quickly. She thought about approaching her louban at the teahouse, but he would ask too many questions and the whole Chinese community would wonder why she was borrowing money from her boss.

facts.fact: 海哥（Hoi gor）或许更嘴严，可"白蛇"（white snakes）毁掉的那座仓库让他损失惨重、而这都怪她无能——不好再去动这条船。
facts.anchor: Perhaps Hoi gor could be relied upon to be more discreet. But he had made a big loss on the warehouse the white snakes had destroyed, due to her ineptitude – better not rock that boat.

facts.fact: 只剩一个人太讲礼貌、不会追问：只要她哭诉要养家，他大概就会心软、当场掏空口袋——她需要的是一个英国人。
facts.anchor: There was only one person too polite to ask questions. Who would crumble if she gave a sob story about supporting her family and probably empty his pockets immediately.
